30th 10:00am pat riordan, 1st anniversary we rememb er all those who died recently. confessions on saturday at 4:30pm or by appointment. bereavement /remembrance mass the bereavement mass will be celebrated on monday november 2nd at 7:30pm, all souls day. this mass is for all those who have died in the past year and an opportunity for their families to remember them with the parish community. there will be a candle with the name of each person who has died at the back of the church on the evening of the mass and also some extra candles for anyone who wishes to remember a loved one during this bereavement service. novena for the holy souls will take place from the 2nd – 10th november at 10:00am mass novembe r nove na envel opes are available in the church. st vincent de paul collection the next st. vincent de paul collection will be held on the weekend of saturday 31st october and sunday 1st november. we thank you as always for your generosity. cleaning our church like any building, needs regular cleaning and it has been the tradition in this parish that volunteers clean the church weekly. we are grateful to all those who, over many years have generously given of their time to meet this ministry. we appeal each year for volunteers, (male and female) but it is a challenge to find parishioners eager to serve this ministry. the church cleaning task takes one hour on a saturday morning. we currently have 2 teams which means each team does one hour every 2 weeks. if you can help, please contact the parish office. thank you. thursday coffee mornings after 10:00am mass. all welcome . choir: as always, new members are very welcome. practice is on tuesday nights from 7:30 – 9:00pm. october: talks on faith the best kept secrets of our catholic faith following on from the talks by fr. kevin ogorman sma, the final talk will be on thursday 29th october with fr. kevin on "pope leo xiv recent encyclical on catholic social teaching, and our human dignity" the talks will start at 7.30pm in the parish meeting room. there will be time for a cup of tea and discussion after. all are welcome. ireland's 3rd national first saturdays conference this year's conference will take place in knock on saturday november 28th. the day begins at 10am and finishes at 5pm. it includes holy mass, adoration, talks, and a healing service. speakers include: fr patrick cahill, geraldine o'donnell, fr leon pereira op, nikki kingsley, fr marius o'reilly, fr. jaimie twohig, christine o'hara, fr. mark quinn, and fr philip kemmy, fr. john keane will lead a eucharistic healing service. more information and the list of buses going are available on

for novena of masses: mon. to fri. 10.00am / sat. 6.00pm / sun. 10.00am. novena finishes on nov. 10th. our annual novena of masses takes place from 2nd–10th november as follows: mon 2nd: 7.30pm, minane bridge (all souls) tues 3rd & wed 4th: 7.30pm, nohoval thurs 5th–sat 7th: 7.30pm, minane bridge sun 8th: 11.15am, mass of remembrance, nohoval mon 9th & tues 10th: 7.30pm, nohoval prayer petitions may be left in either church or given to the sacristans. parish funeral team our parish funeral team recently met with members from carrigaline and crosshaven, alongside monsignor aid an and fr michael. thanks were expressed to the volunteers their dedication to this important ministry and to the pr iests for their support of bereaved families and their beautiful fu neral homilies. congratulations to tracton junior bhurlers on winning the south east hurling final in riverstick last sunday. well done to all involved!take a short term pledge for november and abstain from alcohol for the month offering it up for the intent ions of the holy souls in purgatory. the pioneer family table quiz will take place on fr iday 13th november at 7.30 pm. in togher community centre t12 tx 2y. refreshments provided. €20 per table. entries for the quiz due by friday 6th november. carrigaline november novena masses will take place 2 - 10 novnd th morning masses will be midweek at 9.30am and there will be an additional 7.30pm in the evenings midweek during the novena. weekend mass times during the novena remain as normal. we will have prayers and blessing of graves at 3pm in st mary’s cemetery on sunday november 8 . th you are most welcome to join us for the novena mass es and the blessing of the graves. carrigaline
